process_steps.input_state: pure metals Ni, Co, Fe, Ti, Al

evidence.quote: Pure metals Ni, Co, Fe, Ti and Al ( ≥ 99.9 wt %) were added into the vacuum suspension melting furnace in argon atmosphere, and the Ni46Co22Fe22Al3Ti7 alloy ingot (at.%, denoted as-cast Al3Ti7 MEA hereafter) was prepared by three repeating melting.
The as-cast Al3Ti7 alloy was homogenized at 1150 ◦C for 8 h to make the alloy composition uniform.
The as-cast Al3Ti7 alloy was homogenized at 1150 ◦C for 8 h to make the alloy composition uniform.

parameters.deformation: multi-step rolling from 5 mm plate to 1 mm sheet

evidence.quote: The homogenized alloy ingot was cut into 5 mm thick plate for cold rolling, through multi-step rolling, the plate is rolled into 1 mm thick sheet.
Then the rolled sheet was recrystallized at 1100 ◦C for 1.5 min to obtain fully recrystallized grains.
Finally, the recrystallized sheet was aged at 700 ◦C for 1 h and water quenched (denoted as-aged Al3Ti7 MEA hereafter).
The as-cast Al3Ti7 alloy was homogenized at 1150 ◦C for 8 h to make the alloy composition uniform.

the other rolled sheet is treated by another heat treatment procedure which is just aged at 700 ◦C for 1 h and water quenched, but without recrystallization treatment
Ni, Co, and Fe element are selected to form the matrix with FCC crystal structure of alloy

attributes.location: inner grain and on the grain boundaries

evidence.quote: the as-cast alloy is composed of equiaxed grains where lots of cubic second phase precipitating in. The average grain size of the equiaxed grain in as-cast Al3Ti7 MEA is no mor than 97 μm. And the average size of the second phase is about 200 nm.
these nano precipitations are L12 phases with superlattice structure. The nano L12 precipitations distribute homogeneously, inner grain and on the grain boundaries.
The high-resolution TEM(HRTEM) of the interface between L12 precipitation and FCC matrix is shown in Fig. 3 (d)

fine cubic nanoparticles uniformly distribute on the alloy matrix, as shown in Fig. 1 (d). In addition, a small number of short-rod precipitations appear at some grain boundaries, as shown in Fig. 1 (e). As shown in Fig. 1 (f), the average size of the cubic nanoparticles precipitated in grain is about 35.4 nm
The SADPs along [01-1] and [1 1-2] zone axes reveal that the short-rod precipitations and the cubic precipitations both have L12 superlattice crystal structure

the as-aged Al3Ti7 MEA is fully recrystallized, with the average grain size decreasing to 26 μm

attributes.size: elongated into centimeter level along rolling direction

evidence.quote: the non-recrystallized Al3Ti7 MEA which is directly aged at 700 ◦C is composed of stretched coarse grains
the non-recrystallized alloy is elongated into centimeter level along the rolling direction
no more than 30 μm, with large volume fraction of high angle grain boundary

attributes.morphology: perpendicular to rolling direction, throughout the whole grain

evidence.quote: Shear band which is perpendicular to the rolling direction throughout the whole grain is the main precipitation site for L12 particles other than grain boundary.
The existing intergranular cracks on the fracture surface of the as-cast Al3Ti7 MEA reveals the fact that the coarse L12 particles deteriorates the strength of the grain boundary.

During deformation of the as-aged alloy, the dislocation movement is hindered intensely by L12 precipitation, which improves the yield strength greatly.

Besides, the fine grain strengthening obtained by thermo-mechanical treatment and solid solution strengthening obtained by the addition of Al and Ti with large atomic radius also contribute to the improvement of yield strength.
solid solution strengthening obtained by the addition of Al and Ti with large atomic radius also contribute to the improvement of yield strength

due to the consistent coherent relationship between the FCC and L12 phases, the dislocation can cut through the particles and continue to slip, which reduces the stress concentration on the interface between the FCC and L12 phases and improves the plasticity of the as-aged Al3Ti7 MEA

Grain boundary in high volume fraction is the crack initiation site and propagation channel and is the main factor of the low elongation of the as-aged alloy. This is an intermediate temperature embrittlement which is typically intergranular fracture

The coarse grains with elongated morphology in the non-recrystallized alloy drastically reduce the connectivity of grain boundary and consequently suppresses the nucleation and propagation of cracks along with them.
